asked.item: when should numbers show on Starter

verdict.reason: The sentences state what "Analytics pending" means, that it does not establish an account-connection failure, and the Starter first-collection timing, so the customer's timing and account questions can be answered without guessing.

steps.text: "Analytics pending" means no metric history is available yet.
Pending does not mean your account is broken, because it does not establish an account-connection failure.
On the Starter plan, the first metrics are collected at 1 day after the post publishes, and a post shows no metrics until that first checkpoint passes.
TikTok analytics are supported by Blotato.
